name: kleora
description: Manage your Kleora account from your coding agent: apps, clients, users, tenants, roles and the audit log, as you, over the management API — plus the skills that say how to use them correctly.

api_base_url.title: Management API base URL
api_base_url.description: Leave empty to use the hosted platform, https://api.kleora.io. Set it only if you run Kleora yourself and point it at your own management API. One URL covers both sandbox and production — they are separate environments behind the same API, not separate hosts.

profile.title: Credential profile
profile.description: Leave empty to use the profile named "default". Which stored credential to use: two accounts (say your own and a client's) means two profiles, each authorised separately, so a call can never be made as whoever signed in last.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Drop every tool that writes, so the agent can look but not change anything. A host cannot approve a call that was never offered.

issuer.title: Issuer URL (advanced)
issuer.description: Where the browser sign-in happens. Leave empty: the server asks the management API for it (/api/v1/platform). Set it only for a development setup whose API cannot describe it.
